title: Verify: Lockfile node_modules/phaser entry unit tests
summary: Unit tests for resolved version, URL and integrity
description: Tests read package-lock.json from disk only.
acceptance_criteria: version is 3.90.0 and resolved URL is the 3.90.0 tarball
integrity equals the 3.90.0 sha512 and eventemitter3 range is satisfied by the locked version
technical_constraints: Expected values come from npm registry metadata of phaser@3.90.0

steps.action: Create the file reading package-lock.json with the NodeURL alias pattern; add test 'resolves 3.90.0' asserting entry.version === '3.90.0' and entry.resolved === 'https://registry.npmjs.org/phaser/-/phaser-3.90.0.tgz'; add test 'integrity and deps' asserting entry.integrity equals the 3.90.0 sha512 string, entry.dependencies.eventemitter3 === '^5.0.1', and packages['node_modules/eventemitter3'].version === '5.0.4'
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/phaserLockEntry.test.ts
